headline: Custom Websites. Smarter Business. Lasting Results.
intro: CINTEXA designs and develops responsive, accessible, high-performance websites that help businesses build credibility, explain what they offer, reach customers and turn visitors into qualified enquiries — from a first business website to custom web applications.
metaTitle: Web Design & Development Company in Ghana | CINTEXA
metaDescription: CINTEXA designs and develops responsive business websites, e-commerce stores and custom web applications for startups and established businesses in Ghana.
socialTitle: Web Design & Development Company in Ghana | CINTEXA
imageAlt: CINTEXA web design and development — custom websites, e-commerce and web applications

services.title: Corporate & business websites
services.problem: Customers judge a business by its website before they ever call. An outdated or unclear site costs trust and enquiries.
services.solution: A clear, fast, mobile-friendly website that explains who you are, what you offer and how to get in touch, built on your brand.
benefits: Customers find services, contacts and proof quickly
A foundation you can grow page by page

services.title: Startup & personal websites
services.problem: New ventures and professionals need to look established quickly without a large budget or a long build.
services.solution: A focused site that introduces you, shows your work or offer and gives people one obvious next step.
benefits: Room to add pages as you grow
Easy to share on WhatsApp and social media

services.title: E-commerce & retail websites
services.problem: Selling online needs a catalogue customers can browse, a checkout they trust and orders you can actually manage.
services.solution: An online store with clear product pages, a straightforward ordering flow and order handling that fits how your business works.
benefits: Sell beyond your shop's opening hours

services.title: Hotel & hospitality websites
services.problem: Guests compare options on their phones. Unclear rooms, rates or contact details send them to a competitor.
services.solution: A visual, mobile-first site that presents rooms, facilities, location and ways to enquire or book.

services.title: Insurance & professional-services websites
services.problem: Clients choose advisers they trust. A site has to explain complex services plainly and make contact simple.
services.solution: A credible, plain-language site that organises services, team and enquiry routes, with careful handling of client data.
benefits: Build trust before the first conversation

services.title: Engineering & industrial websites
services.problem: Technical firms need to show capability, standards and projects to buyers who compare suppliers carefully.
services.solution: An organised site that presents capabilities, services and project information, and makes requesting a quotation easy.
benefits: Keep technical content easy to scan

services.title: Landing pages & lead-generation websites
services.problem: Campaign traffic is wasted when it lands on a page that does not match the offer or make the next step obvious.
services.solution: Focused pages built around one offer and one action, with fast loading and measurable enquiries.
benefits: Match the page to the campaign

services.title: Custom web applications & business portals
services.problem: Spreadsheets, chat threads and paper forms slow teams down and hide information customers should be able to see.
services.solution: Secure web applications — dashboards, booking tools, customer portals and workflows — shaped around how your team works.
benefits: One place for records and requests

services.title: Website redesign & modernisation
services.problem: An older site may be slow, hard to use on phones, difficult to update or no longer reflect the business.
services.solution: We review what you have, keep what works, and rebuild structure, design and performance without losing your existing content and links.
benefits: Cleaner structure for visitors and search engines

services.title: Maintenance, performance & technical SEO
services.problem: A site that is launched and then ignored slows down, accumulates errors and stops improving.
services.solution: Ongoing support, performance work and technical SEO fixes — crawlable pages, correct metadata, sitemaps and structured data — scoped to what your site needs.
benefits: A technically sound base for search visibility
Continued improvement as the business grows

process.title: Discovery
process.copy: We learn about your business, customers and goals, and agree what the website must achieve.

process.title: Planning
process.copy: Pages, features, content and integrations are mapped, with a written scope and timeline.

process.title: Design
process.copy: Layouts and visual style are shaped around your brand and tested for clarity on phones and desktops.

process.title: Development
process.copy: The site is built with responsive, accessible code and connected to the forms, payments or tools you need.

process.title: Testing & launch
process.copy: We check devices, forms, speed, accessibility and links before going live, then confirm everything works in production.

process.title: Support & improvement
process.copy: After launch we help you update, measure and improve the site as your business grows.

standards.title: Performance
standards.copy: Optimised images, lean code and sensible loading so pages feel fast on mobile connections. Core Web Vitals are a target we measure, not a promise we make in advance.

standards.title: Accessibility
standards.copy: Semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, visible focus, readable contrast and labelled forms, aiming for WCAG 2.2 AA.

standards.title: Security
standards.copy: HTTPS, validated forms, careful handling of customer information and secrets kept out of browser code.

standards.title: Search-ready structure
standards.copy: Crawlable pages, descriptive titles, clean URLs, sitemaps and structured data that matches what visitors actually see.

faqs.q: How much does a website cost?
faqs.a: The cost depends on scope — how many pages, whether you need e-commerce, bookings or a customer portal, what integrations are involved and how much content has to be produced. We give a written estimate after a short discovery conversation instead of quoting a fixed price before we understand the project.

faqs.q: How long does it take to build a website?
faqs.a: A focused business website takes less time than an online store or a custom web application. We agree a timeline in the project plan once the scope is clear, and tell you early if something changes it.

faqs.q: Will my website work well on phones?
faqs.a: Yes. Every site we build is responsive and checked on phone, tablet and desktop screen sizes, because most visitors in Ghana browse on their phones.

faqs.q: Can you build an online store?
faqs.a: Yes. We build e-commerce websites with product catalogues, checkout and order handling. See our e-commerce solution for details.

faqs.q: Can you redesign my existing website?
faqs.a: Yes. We review what you have, keep the content and links that work, and improve the design, structure and speed. We plan redirects so existing pages do not simply disappear from search results.

faqs.q: Can you guarantee first place on Google?
faqs.a: No one honestly can. Search engines decide rankings. What we do is build a technically sound foundation — crawlable pages, correct metadata, sitemaps, fast loading and useful content — and measure the results, so your site has the best chance of being found.

faqs.q: Do you support the website after launch?
faqs.a: Yes. We can help with updates, performance, technical SEO and new features after launch, scoped to what your site needs.
